title: index.md must be no more than params.maxAgeHours old
untested_rationale: checkPresence() (validate-llms-txt.mjs:215) computes ageHours from a live HTTP response and compares it to params.maxAgeHours -- there is no pure-function input, only a live time delta. params.maxAgeHours IS read on the production call path (validate-llms-txt.mjs:214-215), so the threshold has one home, but operational rules cannot carry cases, so there is no probe-C analogue and a regression here would go unnoticed by this pilot's gates (N3). Covered only by human review of this rule file's diff.

spec.name: llms.txt (llmstxt.org)
spec.normative_quote: index.md has no formal spec of its own. This threshold matches llms-full-txt-stale's rationale: a 30-minute composer cadence, a couple of missed ticks tolerated, plus the prod-domain proxy's 1-hour edge cache.
spec.note: conformance_testable is false; no external spec imposes this threshold.
spec.verification_note: clause n/a -- rule_class: operational. normative_quote is a self-authored statement about the ABSENCE of external spec coverage for this transport/fetch/presence condition; there is no external normative clause to transcribe or verify against a source.
